(One More Time) |nextcode=PS061 |nexttitle=Breath of the Dragonair Part 2 |series=Yellow |colorscheme=Yellow}} {{ChapInfobox |title_en=Breath of the Dragonair Part 1 |title_ja=VS ハクリュー【前編】 |title_ro=VS Hakuryu (Part 1) |image=PS060.png |scheme=Yellow |pub1=Shogakukan full volume |pub1-data=Chapter 60 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|5}} |pub2=VIZ Media monthly issue |pub2-data=Chapter 20 in [[Dratini Of The Deep]] |pub3=VIZ Media full volume |pub3-data=Adventure 60 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|5}} |location={{DL|Vermilion City|Port|Vermilion Harbor}} }} '''Breath of the Dragonair Part 1''' (Japanese: '''VS ハクリュー【前編】''' ''VS {{tt|Hakuryu|Dragonair}} (Part One)'') is the 60th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 20th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Yellow}}. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} The story opens with {{adv|Yellow}} fishing with [[Pika]], [[Ratty]], [[Kitty]], Dody, Gravvy, and Omny. Yellow contemplates how she will cross the sea without a Pokémon that can use {{m|Surf}}. Finding that the only Pokémon around her were {{p|Tentacool}}, she plans to move to another shore, hoping to find a stronger {{type|Water}} Pokémon. She then trains with Pika, as she finds it difficult to sleep. Suddenly, after using {{m|Substitute}}, she hears a cry for help. Soon finding the source, a {{tc|Swimmer}} falling to shore from a large wave, Yellow and Kitty help him, but he is unable to compete in the Surfing Contest that he and his {{p|Slowpoke}} were training for during the accident. Yellow agrees to take part in the contest for him, as the prize is a previously trained {{p|Dragonair}}, which would be perfect for crossing the sea. The Swimmer lends Slowpoke to Yellow for the contest. The story then cuts to [[Blasty]], {{adv|Green}}, and {{adv|Bill}} still pursuing [[Bruno]]'s {{p|Hitmonlee}}. The Hitmonlee then uses its spring-like body to bounce [[Blasty]] off itself. Green and Bill are then separated from Blasty and Hitmonlee. Green then uses [[Voice Recognition Unit|a distant-commanding device]] that traps a command inside a bubble. It then cuts back to [[Vermilion City]], where the Surfing contest has begun. The Dragonair then lashes out, using {{m|Whirlpool}}. [[Lance]] then appears on Dragonair. The story ends with the Whirlpool strengthening and the contestants begin to be pulled down into the sea. ==Major events== * {{adv|Yellow}} tries to get a {{type|Water}} Pokémon to leave {{ci|Vermilion}}. * Yellow enters in a surfing contest for an injured {{tc|Swimmer}}. * Yellow borrows the Swimmer's {{p|Slowpoke}}. * {{adv|Green}} and {{adv|Bill}} continue to chase the {{p|Hitmonlee}}. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Psyduck}} * {{p|Goldeen}} ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Green}} * {{adv|Yellow}} * {{adv|Bill}} * [[Lance]] * {{tc|Swimmer}} * [[Chairtarō]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Blastoise}} ([[Blasty]]; {{adv|Green}}'s) * {{p|Raticate}} ([[Ratty]]; {{adv|Yellow}}'s) * {{p|Doduo}} ([[Dody]]; {{adv|Yellow}}'s) * {{p|Pikachu}} ([[Pika]]; {{adv|Yellow}}'s) * {{p|Graveler}} (Gravvy; {{adv|Yellow}}'s) * {{p|Omanyte}} ([[Omny]]; {{adv|Yellow}}'s) * {{p|Caterpie}} ([[Kitty]]; {{adv|Yellow}}'s) * {{p|Hitmonlee}} ([[Bruno]]'s) * {{p|Dragonair}} ([[Lance]]'s; new) * {{p|Slowpoke}} ({{tc|Swimmer}}'s) * {{p|Psyduck}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Goldeen}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Staryu}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Horsea}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Magikarp}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Tentacool}} (multiple) ==Trivia== ===Errors=== * In one frame, the two orbs on {{p|Dragonair}}'s tail are missing.
